metadata.title: Governance, Compliance, Safety, Privacy, and Communication Readiness Checklist
metadata.reviewCadence: Before each release and at least quarterly
metadata.notice: This document is a planning aid and is not legal, medical, psychological, employment, or security advice.

governance.check: Define purpose, intended users, and foreseeable misuse.
Assign an accountable owner for each risk area.
Maintain an issues log with owner, severity, due date, and resolution.
Document material decisions, assumptions, evidence, and dissenting views.
Provide escalation, complaint, correction, appeal, and accessibility processes.

legal.check: Identify applicable laws and regulations in each operating jurisdiction.
Verify that public, health, employment, and marketing claims are accurate and supportable.
Review consent, retention, deletion, disclosure, licensing, and vendor obligations.
Obtain jurisdiction-specific legal review for high-risk activities.

safety.check: Provide clear warnings for foreseeable physical, emotional, cognitive, or social risks.
Provide an accessible stop, exit, and help-request process.
Do not present automated output as a clinical diagnosis or emergency service.
Document limitations, uncertainty, incident reporting, triage, and rollback procedures.
Review age suitability and the needs of elders, minors, and people with disabilities.

mixedRealityAndPsychologicalAssessment.check: Use voluntary participation and informed consent in plain language.
State whether each instrument is validated, experimental, educational, or entertainment-only.
Do not infer a diagnosis or crisis state from a single interaction.
Minimize biometric, behavioral, voice, eye-tracking, location, and mood-related data.
Provide breaks, grounding instructions, and an immediate exit option.
Obtain qualified clinical, research, or ethics review when appropriate.

privacy.check: Maintain a data inventory with purpose, legal basis, retention, access, and deletion method.
Collect only data necessary for a stated purpose.
Use privacy-by-default settings and minimize logging.
Encrypt sensitive data in transit and at rest.
Restrict access by role and review access regularly.
Do not publish private addresses, credentials, tokens, or unnecessary unique identifiers.
Maintain procedures for access, correction, deletion, and breach response.

security.check: Use unique accounts and prohibit shared credentials.
Use strong passwords, rate limiting, and protection against credential stuffing.
Offer multi-factor authentication for administrators and sensitive accounts.
Apply least privilege and separate administrative accounts.
Use secure sessions, logout, expiration, revocation, and authorization checks.
Keep secrets outside source code and rotate exposed credentials.
Maintain backups, restore tests, audit logs, patching, and incident response.

communityCommunication.check: Offer accessible formats such as large print, high contrast, audio, translation, and human assistance when appropriate.
Explain what information is collected, why it is collected, and who can access it.
Allow time for questions and informed consent.
Provide a non-digital or human contact route where practical.

interpretationAndTranslation.distinction: What was directly seen, heard, measured, or recorded.
The meaning assigned to an observation.
An assertion made publicly or operationally.
Information supporting or limiting a claim.
What remains unknown or could be misunderstood.
interpretationAndTranslation.check: Preserve meaning, cultural context, idioms, honorifics, and technical terms.
Use qualified human review for high-stakes translations.

aiAndLanguageModels.check: Document purpose, limits, data sources, model version, and human oversight.
Test for hallucinations, bias, privacy leakage, prompt injection, and unsafe recommendations.
Keep humans responsible for consequential decisions.
Define escalation rules for emergencies, threats, abuse, and self-harm content.
Use bounded, monitored learning processes rather than unrestricted self-improvement in production.
Summarize research with study type, population, limitations, date, and replication status.

quantitativeAndScientificReview.check: Define variables, units, assumptions, and comparison baselines.
Report uncertainty, sample size, missing data, and material limitations.
For each index or score, document definition, scale, weighting, validation, update date, and interpretation.

resumeAndIndeedReadiness.check: Describe responsibilities and outcomes truthfully and without exaggeration.
Use measurable results only when they can be substantiated.
Remove confidential data, private addresses, credentials, and protected information.
Check dates, titles, links, spelling, and contact details.
Obtain permission before naming clients, communities, or collaborators.

approval.statement: Approval records a reasoned decision based on available information. It does not guarantee legal compliance, safety, security, or positive outcomes.
